units: <cite ref="Onkelos Leviticus 11:29">Targ. Lev. XI, 29</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Terumot 10:5:3">Y. Ter. X, 47ᵇ</cite> <he>הורי</he> … <he>בע׳ חד לאלף</he> R. J. decided in the case of a mouse that a proportion of one to one thousand was required to neutralize it in an intermixture.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 1:3:3">Y. Sabb. I, 3ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>ע׳ דטורא</he> the mountain mouse. Bab.

<cite ref="Shabbat 121b:3">Sabb. 121ᵇ</cite> <he>ההוא עכבר</he>; <cite ref="Beitzah 36b:7">Bets. 36ᵇ</cite> <he>ההוא עכברא</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ההוא עכברתא</he>, corr. acc.; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 50).
Snh. 29ᵇ ע׳ דשכיב אדינרי a mouse lying on denars, a miser.—Pl. עַכְכָּרַיָּיא. Y. B. Mets. III, end, 9ᵇ
